questions.q: 6 workers finish a job in 10 days. How many days will 12 workers take?
questions.explanation: More workers means fewer days: 6 × 10 = 12 × days.

questions.q: In inverse proportion, the ____ of the two quantities stays constant.
questions.explanation: If x increases, y decreases so that xy stays the same.

questions.q: A car at 60 km/h takes 4 hours. At 80 km/h, how long will it take?
Which pair of quantities is in inverse proportion (distance fixed)?
Food lasts 20 days for 10 people. How long will it last for 20 people?
questions.explanation: Double the people means half the days.
